fields.acceptance_criteria: 1. Repeated captures for one session preserve prior transcript turns and only append newly observed turns. 2. The store can read a persisted session back into a SessionRecord. 3. The store can query persisted sessions by simple metadata/text filters within one workspace slug. 4. A hook-facing API accepts a CopilotHookPayload and persists it through the store. 5. cargo test -p session-api covers the new behavior.
fields.title: [session-api] Add hook ingestion and read/query support
